violations.text: Desserts were observed held between 46-50 degrees Fahrenheit in the open-air unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Open-air ambient with the curtain closed was observed at 38 DF. Desserts were voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Desserts in the back of unit were observed at 41 DF. Establishment is to monitor the temperature of food in the open-air unit to ensure that the internal food temperature stays at 41 DF or lower. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

Various food was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of PIC, pasta, and rice were placed hot and covered in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Pasta and rice were placed on to sheet pans at the time of inspection. Proper cooling methods reviewed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

Desserts packaged in the food establishment are lacking complete labels. The address is lacking on label. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

The wall behind the 3-bay sink area has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

The following hand-washing sinks were blocked: 1.Hand sink in the kitchen was blocked by trash can. 2. Hand sink in front area was blocked by a cart. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. PIC relocated trash can and cart at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2025

Trays were observed on top of the hand-washing sink in kitchen area. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. PIC relocated trays. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. PIC relocated can opener to dishwasher to be washed, rinsed and sanitized. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2025
A hand wash sink in the back prep area was observed in poor repair and/or improper adjustment (leak observed and was lacking splash guard). New Violation. Correct By: 11/07/2024
The handle of the deli slicer was in poor repair (handle cracked). PIC instructed to not used slicer until service is provided. New Violation. Correct By: 10/31/2024
The food prep sink and a walk-in cooler were lacking adequate air gaps. New Violation. Correct By: 11/07/2024
The wall behind a chest freezer was observed in poor repair (large whole observed). New Violation. Correct By: 11/07/2024
